positions.commentary: Bill Gates would go long on Amazon, viewing it as a strong company with a focused top-down approach compared to Facebook.
Bill Gates views Facebook (Meta) as a company making one big bet on the Meta Wars, and notes Mark Zuckerberg has become a cost-cutting guy.
Bill Gates would definitely go long on Microsoft.
Bill Gates is famously short Tesla because Elon Musk complains about it on Twitter.

thesis: This episode argues that Bill Gates would take a bullish stance on Amazon, Microsoft, and Meta while maintaining a bearish view on Tesla. The thesis relies entirely on the specific reasoning attributed to Gates regarding these positions, noting his preference for Amazon's focused approach, his view of Meta's singular bet and cost-cutting, and his short position on Tesla driven by Elon Musk's public complaints.

claims.claim: Bill Gates would go long on Amazon, viewing it as a strong company with a focused top-down approach compared to Facebook.
claims.quote: He would go long Amazon. He would definitely go long Microsoft. And he would go long AMD. Those were his fix.

claims.quote: And between the two, I would just, I would just, I just want to do it the Amazon way. I don't want to do the Facebook way. That's just all or none. And Mark has gotten that message now.
